explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why `OneMethod_Task_2`, `TaskSkilledSum_Task_2`, `Hours_Task_2_Method_B`, and `MaxLaborers` are all consistent with the optimal solution even though `y_Task_2_Method_B=1` and `S_Task_2=36.5591` in the solver output. Your answer must trace the change from the original model to the revised one by naming the exact new code constructs (`S_task`, `L_task`, `min_share`, `max_share`, and the new `TaskSkilledSum_{t}` constraints) and the exact CSV fields `min_skilled_share_task2`, `max_skilled_share_task2`, and `skilled_worker_weekly_wage`; then state which previously-binding global constraint was replaced in spirit, and quantify how that redesign changes the objective from 84000 to 86000 yuan. Also interpret the dual/slack meaning of the binding workforce constraints in the LP relaxation (at least `TotalSkilledDef`, `TotalLaborersDef`, and one task-level skill-balance constraint): what does a positive shadow price on a binding constraint mean in business terms, and why would a naive linear extrapolation beyond the reported range be unreliable here?
